stories.title: Rare red aurora over Hanle, Ladakh (Jan 19–20)
stories.body: triggered by an X-class solar flare and CME at 1,700 km/s; G4 geomagnetic and S4 solar radiation storm, the strongest since 2003; first well-documented red aurora from India.

stories.title: Responsible Nations Index launched (Jan 19) by ex-President Ram Nath Kovind
stories.body: India ranked 16th (score 0.551513); Singapore topped, ahead of France, the US and China.
